pageCache.pageTitle: Oak Tree Primary School - Sports, PE Premium & Swimming
pageCache.text:
Sports, PE Premium & Swimming
The Government is providing funding to maintained primary schools, specifically targeting the improvement of PE and Sport. For a full breakdown on how Oak Tree will be spending the grant, please see our Sports Premium Spending Report below.
With the close links drawn between the MSA calendar and the teaching provision, pupils develop skills in their lessons which allow staff to accurately assess and identify pupils to represent Oak Tree in inter-school events. Pupils have therefore experienced new sports and competitions.
As a result of the additional funding, Physical Education now carries a higher profile at Oak Tree. Significant improvements have been made to the PE teaching provision due to the implementation of a new Scheme of Work which ties in with the MSA (Mid Sussex Active) calendar.
Active clubs remain an important part of the learning experience at Oak Tree, with the continuation of more specialised ones such as Tiny Tekkers, Oak Tree Marching Club and Karate as well as the introduction of new and reviving of old ones such as Football, Netball, Hockey.
From an Inclusion perspective, we are now proud to have a girls’ football team to represent the school and our netball club has 28% boys attending.
The development of competitive sport is a high priority for Oak Tree. The new curriculum map allows all pupils the opportunity to participate in competitive sport at the end of each half term block of teaching, with those showing ability or enthusiasm being asked to represent the school in competitions run by the MSA.
During the rest of the academic year, Oak Tree will continue to develop the five areas as specified by the DfE. We expect to:
For further information, please feel free to click on the documents and pages below. Thank you.

Breakfast and After School Clubs
Wraparound Care - Junior Adventures Group
Pioneer Childcare is Rebranding to Junior Adventures Group (JAG)
We’re pleased to share an exciting update regarding the wraparound care provision atour school. Pioneer Childcare, who currently operate our onsite before and afterschool clubs, are rebranding to Junior Adventures Group (JAG) — a nationallyrecognised provider of high-quality wraparound and holiday childcare.
This rebrand brings Pioneer fully into the JAG family, creating a unified identity acrosstheir clubs, teams, and programmes while continuing to deliver the same trusted,friendly, and engaging childcare that families know and value.
What This Means for Our School CommunityThe rebrand will not change the day-to-day experience for children or families.You can expect:- The same dedicated teams delivering high-quality care- The same venue and programme structure, now under JAG’s “Rise Then Shine”,“Stay and Play”, and “Holiday HQ” names.The same commitment to safe, active, and inspiring experiencesThe main change families will notice is a refreshed brand identity — including new JAGpurple branding — and a new booking system launching in January 2026.Important Information for Parents and CarersFamilies who have previously shown interest in Pioneer Childcare but do not currentlyhave an active booking will need to create a new account in the JAG booking systembefore booking sessions for 2026.From January 2026 onwards, all sessions will be booked through the new JuniorAdventures Group platform.
To prepare, new parents/carers will be asked to:
1. Visit the new JAG registration page:https://bookings.junioradventuresgroup.co.uk/Identity/Account/Login
2. Create a new account
3. Enter family and child details, including emergency contacts and medical/dietaryinformation
This simple setup ensures all information is carried across smoothly ahead of the newyear. Please note existing families will be communicated to directly.Booking for 2025 and Early 2026Bookings for the Autumn Term and Winter Holidays (up to 2nd January 2026) willcontinue to be made through the existing Pioneer Childcare booking system until therebrand officially goes live.Book here: https://www.pioneerchildcare.co.uk/
Our Partnership Continues
We’re delighted to continue our partnership with the newly rebranded JuniorAdventures Group (JAG). Although the name and branding are changing, the samefantastic team and high-quality provision remain in place — with the added benefit ofJAG’s national experience and support.We look forward to seeing our school community enjoy the refreshed look and continuedexcellence of our wraparound care.
Should you require after school care, please get in touch with Pioneer Childcare located on our premises. Thank you.
Email: enquiries@pioneerchildcare.co.uk
Discover a fun-filled daily schedule at Pioneer’s Breakfast & After School Clubs! Unforgettable sessions for 4-11 year olds delivered here every day throughout the academic year! Pioneer Childcare is a leading provider of Breakfast and After School Clubs offering fun and affordable childcare delivered in a safe and supervised environment.
Rise then Shine: Pioneer’s Breakfast Clubs, called Rise Then Shine, prepare children’s minds and bodies for a busy school day! A healthy, nutritious breakfast keeps them energised throughout the morning, while the focus on an active start stimulates brain activity and concentration, ensuring children get the most out of their day.
After School Clubs: Pioneer’s After School Clubs, called Stay and Play, offer fun, happy, safe places for children to play freely across age groups and take part in structured activities such as arts and crafts and active play. Providing an energising end to the school day, children can join group activities, enjoy a healthy snack, or chill out with toys and games that are all set up and ready for them to enjoy.
Pioneer’s fun and enriching Breakfast and After School Clubs run daily throughout the academic year.
The Adventure Programme: At the core of Pioneer’s Breakfast and After School Clubs is the Adventure Programme. Comprising seven action-packed categories, this programme is backed by research into child development and created in partnership with experts, providing children with opportunities to develop essential life skills, explore their interests, and have fun. With a wide selection of activities focused on physical education, arts, STEM, and wellbeing, children can whip up tasty treats, get sporty, or unwind with yoga and mindfulness.
The Adventure Programme features seven exciting categories:
🤝 Power Teams: Dive into fun games, thrilling challenges, and dynamic group activities to develop lifelong team skills.
🧠 Brain Boosters: Crack codes, solve puzzles, and engage in captivating science experiments and STEM activities that explore the wonders of the world.
🌍 Global Kids: Embark on a journey to become better global citizens by developing essential life skills and discovering the world around you.
🏃 Super Sports: Participate in energetic and fun sports sessions designed to build essential skills for a lifetime of active living.
🧘 Wellbeing Warriors: Discover activities that enhance happiness, mindfulness, and overall wellbeing.
🚀 Creative Inventors: Unleash your imagination through creative activities that blend arts, materials, and crafts, helping you unlock your inner inventor and discover hidden talents.
🍇 Flavour Fest: Explore food and nutrition with interactive, engaging activities designed to promote healthy eating habits.
In addition to Pioneer’s fun-filled daily schedules featuring a variety of activities, they’ll also have themed weeks and special celebrations throughout the term.
If you do have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to call the friendly Pioneer team on 01444 411 388, or email at enquiries@pioneerchildcare.co.uk

Forest School Lead:
Subject Policy:
Forest School Policy
About
At Oak Tree Primary School, we believe that learning goes beyond the classroom. Our Forest School program provides children with a unique opportunity to explore nature, develop essential life skills, and build a Forest School at Oak Tree Primary School.
At Oak Tree Primary School, our Forest School programme is rooted in a developmental ethos, providing children with regular opportunities to grow, learn, and thrive in a natural environment. Through hands-on experiences in our onsite natural area, children build confidence, resilience, and self-esteem while engaging in stimulating and challenging activities.
Forest School supplements our commitment to continuous provision in Key Stage 1, offering outdoor experiences that nurture essential skills such as teamwork, independence, risk management, and self-motivation through child initiated play.
Forest School

Seastars and Octopus Classes
At Oak Tree Primary School, our early years provision is underpinned by our core values of Kindness, Respect, Resilience, Responsibility, Aspire, and Be Yourself. We are committed to providing a nurturing, stimulating environment where every child can flourish and develop a lifelong love of learning.
We believe that the early years are the foundation upon which all future learning is built. Our intent is to:
We work in partnership with parents to promote children's learning and development and to raise their awareness about supporting children's readiness for starting school. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all children, ensuring that our early years provision provides a safe, healthy, and stimulating environment where every child can grow.
